text:
dmitri: Heads-up — grafana alerts for GPU ECC/Xid are spiking in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Dashboards show transient flake + increased evictions. Can we sync on SLO tuning and replacement cadence? cc @carla @ben :eyes:

ben: link? can you paste the dashboard and top metrics?

 dmitri: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/gpu-health?orgId=1
  quick snapshot: ECC errors = 3.2/min (cluster), Xid bursts = 12 in last 60m, evictions +400% vs baseline, thermal_warnings up 2. config: rolling drain enabled but not auto-replace.

 carla: ok — initial thoughts: (1) don't mass-replace yet, (2) flip ejection policy to 'probation' for cards with >2 Xid bursts/hr, (3) increase drain threshold to 30s to avoid noisy churn, (4) route new low-priority batches to other regions while we triage. cost tradeoff if we shift region traffic.

 alice-oncall: I prefer probation too. If we replace immediately we'll burn spare pool and raise costs. Let's run extended perf tests on flagged cards (run night-run benchmark for 2h). I'll trigger bench and mark nodes as probation.

 dmitri: propose healthscore recompute: health = max(0, 100 - w1*ECC_rate - w2*Xid_burst_rate - w3*thermal_warn - w4*eviction_rate) where w1=8, w2=12, w3=6, w4=5 (tunable). Mark <70 as candidate for replacement after 24h observation window.

 ben: if we edit alerts we should keep signal separation. Suggest two alerts: 
  - gpu_card_degradation_warn (for soft signals) -> pages #infra only at P2
  - gpu_card_degradation_critical (for persistent Xid bursts + evictions) -> page oncall P1
  example PromQL for critical (draft):
  ```
  sum by(card_id)(increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total[15m])) > 10 and increase(nvidia_gpu_evictions_total[1h]) > 2
  ```

 infra-bot: [alert] gpu_card_degradation_critical fired: eu-west-1 (12 matches) — alert_id: a-8237f

 carla: SLO discussion: region-level availability target options: 99.95 vs 99.9. 99.95 forces more hot spare capacity and faster replacements (higher cost). 99.9 tolerates slower replacement and more probation time. For eu-west-1 with high traffic I'd vote 99.95; for smaller regions 99.9.

 dmitri: agreed on region differentiation. Plan: 24h observation window, probation ejection policy, update alert severities, run 1-card canary replacement in us-west-2 tomorrow morning, then reassess metrics after 12h. Who owns creating the JIRA and PR for alert edits?

 alice-oncall: I'll create the JIRA (INFRA-4126) and open the alert PR. tagging @ben for PromQL review and @carla for rollout policy review.

 ben: reviewing PromQL now, will post small tweak in PR.

 carla: I'll draft the replacement playbook section (drain -> bench -> replace -> reimage) and add cost notes.

 dmitri: great. let's reconvene in the #eng-infra weekly stand if any regressions show up. :thumbsup:
